_meta.notes: Reuses the recorded Kerbin ascent (altitude/velocity) as multi-series time-series data for the Graph widget. The capture recorded horizontal and vertical speed in the orbital frame; vessel.flight.orbitalSpeed is their magnitude, sample by sample. synthetic.altBandLow / synthetic.altBandHigh are an artificial +/-(10%+200m) envelope around v.altitude, added purely to exercise the band render path (the real capture has no natural envelope). They share v.altitude timestamps exactly so the index-paired band builder aligns.
